finalSourceInvariants.description: Session.send must resolve redirects when allow_redirects is true.

turns.task: Diagnose why Requests Session.send stopped resolving redirects when allow_redirects is true.

Fix the seeded Requests redirect regression in production source only. In Session.send, preserve redirect resolution when allow_redirects is true. Keep edits inside src/requests/sessions.py.

turns.task: Run the smallest source-invariant verification for the Requests redirect fix.
turns.agentPrompt: Verify the Requests redirect fix with the smallest source-invariant check. Do not broaden into tests unless this check fails.

turns.task: Review the final Requests diff for unrelated edits.

turns.verificationCommand:
git diff --name-only | python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
files=[line.strip() for line in sys.stdin if line.strip()]
raise SystemExit(0 if all(f == 'src/requests/sessions.py' for f in files) else 1)
PY
